title: The Water-Babies
author: Charles Kingsley
description: "The Water-Babies" by Charles Kingsley is a children's novel written in 1862–1863.
longDescription: When young chimney sweep Tom falls into a river and transforms into a "water-baby," he begins a moral education in an underwater world.

rating.sourceTitle: The water-babies: a fairy tale for a land-baby
